title: Status icon
responsibility: Displays a verification marker and lets a person inspect the reason behind it.

inputs.name: StatusIcon.status
inputs.description: Verification state: verified, failed, unverified or unknown. Only verified renders a check and passed styling; all other states render a cross. The marker does not independently evaluate evidence.

inputs.name: StatusIcon.reason
inputs.description: Required explanatory text, used as the accessible label and tooltip. An empty string falls back to “No verification recorded for this revision.”

outputs.name: StatusIcon
outputs.description: Verification button showing a check or cross. Click, keyboard focus or pointer hover opens the explanatory text as a status message; blur or pointer leave closes it. The accessible label and native tooltip carry the same explanation.
